name: Mistress Petra
title: Master Mason
examine: Granite hands, chalk-line eye. Her guild raised the terraces you're standing on, and she can tell you which course her grandfather laid.
lines: Every course in this city is guild work. The mountain holds us up; we return the favor.
My grandfather helped set the Undercroft seal. Last month I swung the first pick that broke it. Family trade, both directions.
Stone doesn't lie, doesn't hurry, doesn't forgive. Best colleague I ever had.
